title.narrative: Project Grant Funding to TLC for SAMALA

description.narrative: The SAMALA project is now into the fourth year of implementation and aims to address land degradation and land tenure security. The project has the following key outcomes: (1) Improved catchment management with sustained land productivity on 20,500 ha of land; (2) Strengthened inclusive community governance structures and local institutions for sustainable management of landscapes targeting 147 Village Natural Resources Management Committees (VNRMCs) with a strong focus on participation of women, youth, children and people with disabilities; (3) Increased land tenure security and community knowledge on existing regulatory frameworks targeting registration of 17,500 hectares of land parcels; and (4) Targeted communities have diversified and strengthened livelihoods through increased productivity of key crops by 30% and reduced post-harvest losses by 12% overall.
